blurb: Guests visit the Oliver House Museum and the L. Caroline Underwood Museum to explore exhibits and collections dating from the 18th century. The center offers genealogical research, historical programs, lectures, reenactments, and tours. It operates as a non-profit relying on memberships and donations to preserve and interpret local history.
